script: Imagine hitting a target the size of a football stadium, moving thousands of miles an hour, with a tiny spacecraft... from 7 million miles away! That's a cosmic bullseye. That's precisely what NASA's DART mission accomplished in 2022. This wasn't an accident, but humanity's audacious first-ever planetary defense test, deliberately crashing a probe into the asteroid Dimorphos to shift its path. Now, two years later, Europe's Hera mission has finally arrived to survey the damage up close. And what it found was a truly chaotic scene of radical transformation. Dimorphos is no longer the same. The impact created an enormous debris plume, dramatically changed Dimorphos' shape, and crucially, altered its orbit. This groundbreaking mission proves we now have the ability to nudge cosmic threats away from Earth, securing our future among the stars.
